Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I bought this first through Amazon. It arrived with broken pieces of the grill cover/lid, which I attribute to Weber's decision to employ cheap plastic composite material to save money. Many similar reviews on Amazon about this problem, which could have been avoided had Weber used better (albeit slightly more expensive) material. You get what you pay for I suppose.

Overall, however, the grill does its main job proficiently: it cooks food well - via both direct and indirect heating methods. The ceramic coated cast iron grates are a nice touch and relatively easy to keep clean. I purchased the iGrill accessory (toy) and regret it. A waste of money unless you're cooking giant roasts all the time. Not needed whatsoever (i.e., doesn't work well) for burgers, fish, chicken, steaks and dogs, since they're too thin to consistently get accurate temperature readings. More tried and true methods such as keeping track of time to rotate the food work better IMO. 

I do enjoy using it. It does its job. I'm used to if and will keep it. That said, I think I overpaid for what I got given the quality issues. I'm sure there are other grills out there that provide more bang for the buck.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: A great grill that meets my expectations and so far has produced excellent results. One thing to understand is that the grill is designed to produce an even heat over the grill surface, so there are no "blazing" hot spots, but also no cool ones. Depending on what yo u want to do, cook time may therefore be a bit longer than you might be used to, but perfectly done steaks (and other foods) will result if you monitor the cooking time properly. (Use of the companion Weber iGrill meat temperature probes with its smart phone or pad app is highly recommended for optimal results.)

First the grill does not get hot enough for my likings when I want to sear a stake or do something like making smash burgers. The other complaint is on the price and availability of the igrill 3 component. I can not find a brick and mortar that has this item in stock. Originally was able to purchase online for $60 but because it is so scarce, price on Amazon has gone up about $20.00. This has diminished some of the pleasure of buying your product. Very disappointing that associated components not available at the time and place of the purchase! Sounds like poor planning by Weber.

Results.ReviewText: Ive been through 3 stainless grills in the last 8 years, they all rust out and have a 1-2 year warranty. I can’t believe this grill from Weber has a 10 year warranty! I’ve wasted so much money on junk inferior grills. This 3 burner gets hotter than my old 4 burner, it creates beautiful grill marks on dogs, burgers, brats and chicken breasts and thighs. I absolutely love this new Weber.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: My new grill was delivered in a late spring blizzard. If that was an omen, it was a good one.  The grill heats evenly, and is easy on propane.  I like the two sided grate and it’s easy to clean.  The grill flares only rarely and only because I was inattentive.  When my old Weber grill died I bought another brand.  I threw it away after only two years and bought my new Weber.  I’ll never have anything else.
Results.Title: I’ve come back to Weber
